MORE:
Modern Shares & Stockbrokers Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 30/10/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve  un-audited results for the 2nd Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

The notice has been issued pursuant to Regulation 29(1) (a) & 29(2) of the Listing Regulations.

Please note that as informed in our letter dated October 1, 2026, the Trading Window has been closed from Thursday, October 1, 2026 and the said window shall open 48 hours after the outcome of the aforesaid meeting is made public.
